messages:
Jane Doe (Acme): Hi team — onboarding hit a blocker. Our app is getting 403s when calling the Redwood API. We just copied the API key from the console but still seeing: 

Jane Doe (Acme): curl result: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": "invalid_api_key",
  "message": "No active API key found for project: acme-prod"
}
```

Jane Doe (Acme): We’re certain the client is sending Authorization: Bearer <KEY>. Any idea? Ticket: #SUP-9821

Mia (Support): thanks for the details, Jane. I can take a look. Quick Qs — which organization and project in the console did you copy the key from? Also are you using our hosted endpoint api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?

Jane Doe (Acme): Organization: Acme Inc (org-acme). Project in the UI shows "acme-prod" (id: proj-acme-prod). Endpoint is api.redwood.ai/v1/generate. Code example: 
```
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer pk_live_abc123', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-small', input: 'hello' })
})
```

Mia (Support): got it — thanks. I’ll check the backend logs for that key and project. @deploy-bot can you fetch the key metadata for pk_live_abc123?

deploy-bot: Querying key metadata... 
```
key: pk_live_abc123
status: active
scopes: [inference:generate]
created_by: jane.doe@acme.com
linked_project: proj-acme-internal
```

Mia (Support): aha — the key is linked to proj-acme-internal, not proj-acme-prod. That would explain the project mismatch. The API will reject requests when the key's linked_project doesn't match the requested project context. Did you recently create multiple projects during setup?

Jane Doe (Acme): oh! we did create a temp project earlier (acme-internal) and I guess the key was created there. How do we move it to acme-prod?

Rohit (Onboarding): two options: 1) create a new key scoped for acme-prod from the Project -> API Keys page, or 2) if you want to reuse this exact key, I can re-link it to the acme-prod project on the back end (requires approval). Easiest is to create a new key in the correct project and update the app.

Mia (Support): quick repro steps for the client to validate locally: 
1) In Console: Switch to project "acme-prod" (top-left project dropdown)
2) Settings -> API Keys -> Create new key -> name e.g., "acme-prod-integ-01" and grant scopes: inference:generate, embeddings:read (if used)
3) Replace the Authorization header value with the new key and retry the curl/fetch. 

Mia (Support): example curl to test: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_live_newkey" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"test"}'
```

Jane Doe (Acme): trying now — creating new key...

Jane Doe (Acme): ok created key pk_live_newXYZ, updated app, retrying...

Jane Doe (Acme): SUCCESS — 200 and response body looks good. Thanks! :tada:

Mia (Support): awesome. Two follow-ups: 
- If you want us to rotate keys without downtime, create a second key in the same project and do a hot swap (update env var, restart).
- If billing or project permissions are blocking key creation for anyone on your team, ping @Lin and we can add the right role (Project Admin or API Key Creator).

Lin (Customer Success): noted — Jane if you need us to enable team roles or assign an owner, happy to assist. I’ll check if the onboarding checklist showed multiple sample projects (we’ll remove confusing names).

Rohit (Onboarding): one internal note — I’ll follow up to see why the provisioning flow suggested creating keys in the temp project. Might need to make the project selection step more obvious during the quickstart. Filing follow-up doc change: ONB-312.

Jane Doe (Acme): thanks all. Do you recommend deleting the old key pk_live_abc123?

Mia (Support): yes — after confirming no other services use it. From Console: Project (acme-internal) -> API Keys -> Revoke. If you want us to revoke it for you, confirm and we’ll do it.

Jane Doe (Acme): please revoke. Also can you confirm that the revoked key won’t affect historical logs? We need the audit logs for our compliance review.

Mia (Support): revoking will prevent further calls, but logs and audit trail entries remain in the Console audit logs for 90 days (per our retention policy). I’ll revoke now and add an audit note.

deploy-bot: Revocation request accepted for pk_live_abc123 by Mia. status: revoked. 

Mia (Support): done — pk_live_abc123 revoked. Confirmed audit entry created under ticket SUP-9821. 

Jane Doe (Acme): confirmed — app is green and QA passed. Appreciate the fast help!

Mia (Support): great to hear. Closing the ticket; ping us anytime. :raised_hands:
